description: [WRITE] Create a TikTok Events API SERVER tag from the Stape template (stape-io/tiktok-tag), imported automatically. pixelId is the TikTok Pixel Code (public), accessToken the Events API token. `event` is the TikTok event (CompletePayment, SubmitForm, a GA4 name is mapped). User data, event properties and the event_id dedup key are mapped from `ed - …` Event Data variables, which this tool creates in the workspace when they are missing. containerId must be the SERVER container. Needs a SERVER trigger (triggers_create) passed as firingTriggerId. Requires GTM_MCP_ENABLE_WRITES=true and confirm=true.

accessToken.description: TikTok Events API access token, usually a {{variable}} so it is not stored in plain text on the tag.

confirm.description: Must be true to confirm this write operation.

containerId.description: The SERVER container ID (for the plan tool: the WEB container).

firingTriggerId.description: SERVER trigger id(s) the tag fires on (triggers_create, type customEvent). Usually one.

name.description: Tag name; defaults to "TikTok CAPI Tag".

name: create_tiktok_capi_server_tag
